item.title: Parents protest at Lakeside High over DeKalb plan to shut down 22 schools

item.title: Judicial emergency declared after Floyd County historic courthouse fire
item.description: A judicial emergency has been declared in Floyd County following a massive fire that heavily damaged the historic courthouse, forcing its temporary closure and disrupting court operations.

item.title: Long lines ease slightly Tuesday at Atlanta airport after delays
item.description: TSA staffing shortages led to widespread delays and hours-long security lines at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport.

item.title: Georgia bill aims to end clock changes twice a year
item.description: Lawmakers introduced the “Georgia Sunshine Protection Act" to eliminate switching clocks twice a year.

item.title: Gwinnett sheriff backs Judge Hatchett publicly
item.description: Gwinnett County Sheriff Kebo Taylor voiced support for Judge Glenda Hatchett despite tensions within law enforcement.

item.title: DeKalb police break up drug operation with new real time crime center
item.description: DeKalb County Police said their new Real Time Crime Center helped in the seizure of 26 guns and a massive amount of fentanyl during a drug raid in Stone Mountain.

item.title: Georgia Tech names new head coach for men's basketball
item.description: Georgia Tech has hired Scott Cross as the new head coach of its men’s basketball program, bringing in a proven winner to help rebuild the struggling team.

item.title: Sixth arrest made in Newton County gas station shootout
item.description: A 16-year-old has turned himself in as the sixth suspect arrested for a New Year's Day shootout at a Covington Circle K.

item.title: Atlanta weather: Cooler temps today, pollen count still high
item.description: Pollen count soared above 6,000 Monday, marking the highest level so far this season.

item.title: Special event highlights stories behind iconic aircraft
item.description: Guests at the Delta Flight Museum will have a chance to "meet" some iconic aircraft – and hear the stories behind them – during a special event happening next week.
